question: What great accomplishment of enjoyment and liberation becomes dear to the yoginīs?
premises: A great accomplishment combines enjoyment and liberation
This accomplishment relates to the yoginīs
Such accomplishment may become dear to them
inference: The great accomplishment of enjoyment and liberation may become dear to the yoginīs.
plain_english: The great accomplishment of both enjoyment and liberation may become dear to the yoginīs.
